7. िह बगीचा प्यारा लग रहा है। (Vah bageecha pyara lag raha hai.)
8. ये लाका अप्रमत है। (Ye ladka Amit hai.)
9. ि  लाका र हन है। (Vo ladka Rohan hai.)
10. िह लाके गाूँि से आए हैं। (Vah ladke gaon se aayein hain.)
11. िे असली प्रबखल्रयाूँ नहीों हैं। (Ve asli billiyan nahi hain.)
12. इस कार क  क्या हआ? (Is car ko kya huwa?)
13. क्या तुम इस लाके क  जानती ह ? (Kya tum is ladke ko jaanti ho?)
14. ि  गमले लाल रोंग के हैं। (Vo gamle laal rang kai hain.)
15. ये बच्े हूँस क्य ों रहे हैं? (Ye bachche hans kyun rahe hain?)
16. आपने िह घाी कहाूँ से खरीदी? (Aapne vah ghadi kha se khareedi?)
17. ये सब्जी बहत टेस्टी है। (Ye sabzi bahut tasty hai.)
18. मुझे ि  खखाकी पेंट करनी है। (Mujhe vo khidki paint karni hai.)
19. मैं उन प्रकताब ों का ध्यान रखूूँगा। (Main un kitaabon ka dhyan rakhunga.)
20. िह मेरी िेिरेट जगह है। (Vah meri favourite jagah hai.)
21. मुझे ये म बाइल खरीदना है। (Mujhe ye mobile kharidna hai.)

25. आइए, इस बारे में बात करते हैं। (Aaeye, is bare me baat karte hain.)

तुमने मुझे पैसे की कीमत समझायी। (Tumne mujhe paise ki keemat samjhayee.)
मैं तुम्हें समझा नहीों पाया। (Main tumhein samjha nahi paaya.)
मैंने तुमसे बाल्टी कब भरिाई? (Maine tumse baltee kab bharvai?)
उसने तुमसे इतने पैसे क्य ों खचि करिाये? (Usne tumse itne paise kyo kharch karvaye?)
मैंने हर प्रकसी क  इस ह टल में खाना खखलिाया। (Maine har kisi ko is hotel me khana khilvaya.)

तुम ये काम कब तक खत्म करिा सकते ह ? (Tum ye kaam kab tak khatm karva sakte ho?)
हमने उसे िहाूँ प्रभजिाया पर उसने काम नहीों प्रकया। (Humne use vahaan bhijvaya par usne kaam nahi kiya.)
उसने मुझे अच्छा खाना खखलाया, ज  उसकी मम्मी ने पकाया था। (Usne mujhe achchha khana khilaya, jo uski mummy ne pakaya tha.)
उसने मुझे कम्प्प्यूटर प्रसखाया / प्रसखिाया। (Usne mujhe computer sikhaya/sikhvaya.)
उस आदमी ने हमें लस्सी प्रपलाई/प्रपलिाई। (Us aadmi ne hamein lassi pilaee/pilvaee.)

10. Whenever I needed him, he helped.
11. All sweet memories get afresh, whenever I hear his name.
12. Whenever you need money, don’t hesitate.
13. Wherever I lived, my landlords were very cooperative.
14. Wherever you go, you will find me there.
15. Wherever you want to go, you can.
16. Wherever he goes, he will find me there.
17. Wherever you see, there's garbage everywhere.
18. Wherever he is hidden, I will find him.
19. I am ready to play with, whoever/whomever you select for this match.
20. Whoever/whomever you want to send with me, you can. I’ve no issues at all.
21. Whoever is the thief, will not be able to escape.
22. Whoever wants to eat, can go there.
23. Whoever finds this ball first, will bat first.
24. Your brother or whoever was there in that house that day is culprit.
25. Whichever the book you like the most, you should buy that.
26. Whichever method out of these you adopt; you will not get the solution of this
problem.
27. Whoever you are, you will protect him.
28. Whichever/whoever you think is the best player, you can take him in your team.
29. Whichever/whoever of you comes here first, will get the prize.
30. Whichever side wins, I will be satisfied.
31. Whatever you buy, that has a six-month guarantee.
32. However you behave with him, he will not feel bad.
33. However clothes he wears; it makes no different.
34. You should solve this problem, however you can.
35. I want you to give me that book, however you can.
36. I know you have given months to this project. However, I think it’s not worthwhile.
37. I taught him so much. Still/However, he failed.
38. I have already developed a video on this topic. However I feel I should explain it
to you a little more in detail.
39. Whichever vehicles have got punctured tires, please get them fixed/repaired.
40. However you want to play there, go and play.
41. Whosever/whoever’s homework is not complete, please raise your hands.
42. Whosever/whoever’s pen you have taken, return him right now.
43. However difficult it is to learn English, I will do it for sure.
44. Whoever’s salary is not credited yet, please come here.
45. Whoever curses the king gets stones thrown at him.

Fill in the blanks with the appropriate word given in brackets below.
1. The minority community shouldn’t be ……. (prosecuted, persecuted) by the majority.
2. The kings of the Maurya empire are listed here in a ……… (historical, historic) manner.
3. The Prime Minister delivered a ……….. (historical, historic) speech today.
4. I was ……….. (born, borne) in Dehradun.
5. All the expenses are to be ……….. (born, borne) by the company.
6. He has always been a very ……… (amiable, amenable) child.
7. She is certainly an ……… (amiable, amenable) boss to work with.
9. He visits my house on ………. (alternative, alternate) days.
10. Working twelve hours a day is no doubt …… (exhaustive, exhausting).
11. A meeting of the ………. (council, cabinet) of ministers is to be held in this hall today.
12. You are not ………. (illegible/ eligible) for this post because you are not graduate.
13. His handwriting is so ………. (illegible/ eligible) that nobody can read it.
14. Haridwar comes on the train ……….. (route, rout) to Dehradun.
15. His brother is a very …………… (sensible, sensitive) person.
16. He is very ……… (sensible, sensitive) to people’s reactions on his actions.
17. All the pleasures and the problems are just … (momentary, momentous); don’t worry.
19. I’m sure, he has done some ………. (tempering, tampering) with the secret documents.
20. That model had a ……… (gracious, graceful) appearance in the show.
21. He is a  ……… (gracious, graceful) person by nature, as he does lots of social work.
23. The big businessmen stay at the luxurious ……… (mansions/ mentions) only.
24. The house got demolished due to heavy ………… (lightning/ lightening) last night.
25. I will …………. (practice, practise) speaking a lot to become a fluent speaker.
26. They have done so much ………….. (practice, practise) in order to win the game.

30. He is in …………. (judicious, judicial) custody right now.

Q1: Choose the best alternatives:

1. हमे भेज़ा गय़ा। (Hume bheja gaya.) 
a) We were sent. 
 
b) We were to go.    
c) We were made go.  
d)  We were let go. 
 
2. ऱाम को ड़ाँट़ा ज़ा रह़ा थ़ा। (Ram ko daanta ja raha tha.) 
a) Ram was scolding.  
b) Ram was being scold.  
c) Ram was being scolded.  d)Ram was made scolded.

3. उसे मुझसे दमलव़ाय़ा ज़ायेग़ा। (Use mujhse milwaya jayega.) 
a) He will be meeting me.   
 
b) He will be made meet me.                                     
c)   He will be made to meet me.   
d) He will make me meet.

4. तुम्हें क्य़ा दसख़ाय़ा ज़ात़ा है? (Tumhein kya sikhaya jaata hai?) 
a) What are you taught?  
 
b) What are you be taught?                                       
c)   What do you be taught?  
 
d) What are you learned? 
 
5. मुझे दभजव़ाय़ा गय़ा। (Mujhe bhijwaya gaya.) 
a) I was sent.  
b) I was made sent.  
c) I was made go. 
d) I made go.

6. उन्हें बत़ाय़ा गय़ा थ़ा। (Unhe bataya gaya tha.) 
a) They were told. 
 
b) They had been told.       
c) They were informed.     d) They were been told.

b) Why did you not let go?                                                   
c)   Why were you not let go?  
d) Why were you not let gone?

a) Will we be let play today? 
b) Will we be made play today?                                            
c)   Will we let play today?  
d) Will we get the play today?

a) I can get the work done.
